title: Administrator
description:
Receptionist / Administrator

Location: Walsall
Hours: 6:30am - 4:00pm
Pay Rate: 12.71 per hour
Contract: Temporary to Permanent
Start Date: Immediate

We are currently recruiting for a Receptionist / Administrator to join our client's team based in Walsall. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is organised, confident dealing with people, and comfortable working across a varied administrative role.

The Role

The successful candidate will be responsible for a range of day-to-day administrative and office duties, including:
- Welcoming and dealing with visitors in a professional and friendly manner
- Answering queries and supporting reception duties
- Completing general data entry and maintaining accurate records
- Managing stock levels and carrying out stock control
- Raising and managing purchase orders
- Liaising with suppliers and internal departments

About You

We are looking for someone who is:
- Organised and reliable
- Confident communicating with staff, visitors and suppliers
- Comfortable using computer systems and completing data entry
- Able to manage multiple tasks and prioritise workload
- Professional and approachable
- Previous reception, administration, stock control or purchasing experience would be advantageous

What's on Offer?
- 12.71 per hour
- 6:30am - 4:00pm
- Temporary-to-permanent opportunity
- Immediate start available
- Varied role with excellent exposure to administration, stock control and purchasing
- Walsall-based position

If you are looking for a varied administrative role and feel you have the skills and experience required, apply today!

title: Fleet Administrator
description:
Fleet Administrator
The Role:
The Fleet Administrator will support the Fleet Coordinator and Fleet Supervisor in the daily management of the fleet operation. This encompasses a range of responsibilities, which includes overseeing the shared fleet mailbox, facilitating enquiries, transfers, and off-hire requests, as well as managing the processing of charges in our invoicing system.
Key Responsibilities:
- Maintain accurate fleet records within the hire system, including vehicle allocations, driver transfers, off-hires, insurance details and maintenance history.
- Request hire vehicles and coordinate deliveries and collections with suppliers, drivers and regional contacts.
- Support new starters and vehicle changes, ensuring driver records, paperwork, fuel cards and charge cards are in place.
- Administer the online driver licence system, processing checks, maintaining records and escalating outstanding checks or licence concerns.
- Administrate driver e-risk assessments, online inductions and assigned training, monitoring completion and following up on overdue actions.
- Maintain driver and vehicle records across the telematics systems, prepare monthly regional reports and escalate issues requiring attention.
- Monitor the Daily Defect app, follow up on missing checks and outstanding defects, and liaise with drivers, regional teams and maintenance providers.
- Process vehicle damage notifications, raise workshop jobs and administer driver recharges where applicable, in line with company policy.
- Maintain the Motor Insurance Database (MID), ensuring vehicles are added and removed within the required timescales.
- Maintain Dartford Crossing and Transport for London accounts, ensuring vehicle details and charges are accurate.
- Process driving and parking penalty notices, maintain records and follow up on outstanding actions through to closure.
- Order, issue and cancel fuel and charge cards, maintain the card register and prepare monthly commercial van fuel expenditure reports.
- Complete daily system reconciliations, checking vehicle, driver, hire and account records across fleet systems and resolving discrepancies.
- Check and process supplier invoices against agreed rates, hire periods and authorised work, following up on queries and outstanding credits.
- Respond to day-to-day fleet enquiries from drivers, regional teams and suppliers, escalating issues where required.
- Provide administrative support to the Fleet Manager on projects and fleet improvement initiatives.

Key measures & targets:
- Accurate and timely processing of hires, invoices and fleet administration.
- Daily reconciliations completed, with discrepancies resolved promptly.
- Fleet systems and registers maintained accurately and kept up to date.
- Compliance actions and monthly reports completed within agreed deadlines.

Key relationships:
- Fleet Manager
- Fleet Supervisor
- Fleet Coordinator
- Suppliers

Person Specification:
The successful candidate is likely to meet all of the following criteria:
Essential
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office Excel
- Good administrative and organisational skills
- Able to complete tasks and meet deadlines

Desirable
- Experience of working in a Hire, Transport or Fleet management team
- Product knowledge would be beneficial
- Commercial understanding

About BCS Group:
BCS Group, a subsidiary of Barhale Holdings Plc, is a privately owned company. We are a leading supplier of safety and construction products based in the Midlands. We pride ourselves on providing a first-class service to all our customers, ensuring the right product or solution is delivered to the right location on time. With over 5,000 items within our core range, BCS Group can fulfil any order and ensure it is delivered directly via our dedicated transport fleet or those of our partners.
Manufacturing: Our capabilities include standard and bespoke signage, labels, temporary and permanent road traffic signs and bespoke steel fabrication/installation which includes footbridges, walkways, flooring, guardrails, ladders and tunnelling products.
Extensive Stock Range: Distributor of leading industry brands in PPE & clothing, traffic management, safety & lifting and site equipment products. These include Boll , Pulsar, Globus, Rock Fall, Progarm, Portwest, Melba Swintex, Oxford Plastics, JSP, Nissen, Carters, Orafol, Crowcon, Radiodetection, Dr ger, Ridgegear, and Plant Nappy.
Safety Equipment Servicing: Specialist safety & lifting repair, calibration and inspection since 1999. We have our own purpose-built maintenance and calibration facility for gas detection, cable avoidance, breathing apparatus and lifting equipment which along with our fully equipped mobile calibration unit is where all maintenance and repairs are carried out. Our staff are trained and fully qualified in the maintenance, calibration and inspection of a full range of specialist safety & lifting equipment.
Our People: With a direct workforce philosophy, the company culture is driven by our core values, which describe how we act day-to-day. We ensure all your needs are met through our national call centre and dedicated account management.
Triple Accreditation: ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, ISO 45001:2018 and ISO 50001:2011 standards, which means our customers can have complete confidence that we have an ongoing commitment to be a safe, efficient and responsible partner.
Caring and investing in you
As a Gold Investors in People company and a Sunday Times 100 Best Company to Work For, we are committed to investing in people. We are passionate about creating a working environment where people are supported throughout their careers, where people can enjoy security and be part of a company that cares about them.
From the moment you join us, your well-being and career aspirations will be supported by.
- Competitive salary
- Company Pension
- Life Assurance
- Private Medical
- 25 days annual leave in addition to 8 public bank holidays and loyalty days
- 8 hours volunteering
- Employee Assistance Programme to support your mental, physiological, and financial well-being.
- Flexible benefits via salary sacrifice
- Company car/green car scheme/car allowance/Van (dependent on position)
- Leadership & management training and coaching
- Regular line management engagement and appraisal to support your career progression.
- Development supported by internal and externally delivered training.
- Continuous service awards

How to apply:
Please send your current CV and cover email outlining your suitability for the role and quoting the reference number (url removed).

title: Income Collection Administrator
company: Opus People Solutions Ltd - Agency - Temporary
description:
Income Collection Administrator

Location: Walsall, WS1 - onsite for training and then moves to Hybrid basis.

Pay Rate: 14.14 per hour PAYE

Hours: Full Time, 37 hours per week, Monday to Thursday: 8:45am - 5:15pm (1-hour unpaid break), Friday: 8:45am - 4:45pm (1-hour unpaid break)

Contract Length: 12 Months Initially (with potential for extension)

About the Role

Opus People Solutions are recruiting on behalf of our Client, Walsall Council, for an experienced Income Collection Administrator to join a busy finance team. This is an excellent opportunity for a detail-oriented administrator with a finance, credit control, income collection or reconciliation background to support a high-volume service environment.

The successful candidate will play a key role in supporting income collection processes, resolving customer queries, maintaining accurate financial records and ensuring income-related transactions are processed efficiently and accurately.

Following an initial on-site training period, hybrid working arrangements will be available, with office attendance requirements discussed with the hiring manager.

Key Responsibilities
- Processing customer account set-ups and maintaining accurate records.
- Raising and processing credits, including investigating and resolving discrepancies.
- Reviewing spreadsheets and financial data to identify errors and inconsistencies.
- Managing finance-related enquiries received via internal helpdesk tickets, emails and correspondence.
- Handling customer queries relating to income collection activities.
- Supporting reconciliation processes and ensuring financial records remain accurate.
- Processing and inputting data onto internal systems with a high level of accuracy.
- Taking card payments over the telephone in line with procedures.
- Printing, preparing and processing financial documentation.
- Managing incoming and undelivered post, including scanning and distributing correspondence to the appropriate departments and arranging re-delivery where necessary.
- Liaising professionally with members of the public, councillors and internal stakeholders.
- Meeting service deadlines and managing workloads effectively within a fast-paced environment.
- Following established financial procedures whilst using initiative to resolve issues independently.

Essential Experience and Skills
- Previous experience within a finance administration, income collection, credit control or reconciliation environment.
- Experience raising credits and investigating financial discrepancies.
- Strong administration and data entry experience with excellent attention to detail.
- Previous experience processing telephone card payments.
- Experience working with spreadsheets and financial information.
- Customer service experience, including handling and resolving customer queries.
- Previous experience using finance systems and helpdesk/ticketing systems is beneficial
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines consistently.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Confident using Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and Outlook.
- Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team.
- Flexible and adaptable approach to changing priorities and workloads.

What We're Looking For

We are seeking a proactive and organised individual who thrives in a structured finance environment. The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical skills, a keen eye for detail and the ability to deliver excellent customer service whilst maintaining accuracy across financial processes.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a finance administration, income collection, credit control or accounts support background who is looking for a long-term assignment with the potential for extension.

Apply Now!

All offers will be subject to satisfactory compliance screening, including right to work in the UK and references

title: Project Support Officer
description:
Belmont Recruitment are currently looking for an experienced Project Support Officer to join Walsall Council on a temporary contract. This role will support the administration and day-to-day coordination of the National Supervised Toothbrushing Scheme across Walsall. This role is working 30 hours per week.

Key Responsibilities
- Coordinate the day-to-day administration and delivery of the supervised toothbrushing programme.
- Maintain accurate stock records for programme resources, including toothbrushes, toothpaste and other supplies.
- Organise deliveries and collections to participating nurseries and primary schools.
- Manage storage arrangements and travel between the storage facility and council offices as required.
- Maintain accurate records, trackers and reports, providing updates to local and national programme leads.
- Act as the main point of contact for participating schools and nurseries, responding to queries and providing guidance.
- Liaise with approved training providers to coordinate training for participating settings.
- Use Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, to maintain data, prepare reports and manage correspondence.

Requirements
- Previous experience in project support, project coordination or administration.
- Strong organisational skills, with the ability to coordinate logistics and maintain accurate records.
- Excellent communication skills and confidence liaising with schools and other stakeholders.
- Ability and willingness to travel between council offices and storage facilities as required.

Please apply with an up-to-date CV ASAP if you are interested in this opportunity.

title: Service Administrator
description:
Alma Personnel are pleased to announce we are looking for an organised, proactive and reliable Service Administrator to join our clients' team on a full time, permanent basis to provide essential administrative support to the service department.

The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring the smooth and efficient running of daily service operations, supporting field engineers, coordinating service schedules and maintaining accurate records.

Job Duties of a Service Administrator:-
- Organise engineer schedules and allocate planned maintenance work to ensure customer requirements are met and resources are used effectively.
- Create and maintain customer service agreements, ensuring records are accurate and contract information is kept up to date.
- Arrange statutory and other required thorough examinations, track completion dates, maintain associated records and coordinate follow-up actions where issues are identified.
- Prepare customer invoices using completed service documentation, checking information carefully before processing.
- Review timesheets and job reports, resolve discrepancies and ensure all relevant paperwork is completed and filed correctly.
- Monitor work that cannot be charged to customers, check that the necessary approvals are in place and refer items requiring further review to management.
- Support the service team by taking breakdown requests, recording new jobs on the system and ensuring urgent work is appropriately prioritised.
- Respond to telephone calls and enquiries professionally, pass information to the relevant colleagues and help keep customers informed about service arrangements.
- Maintain organised electronic and paper records, update staff holiday information, monitor outstanding paperwork and assist with general departmental administration.
- Provide reception and telephone cover when required, welcome visitors, distribute incoming correspondence and prepare outgoing post.
- Keep track of scheduled and outstanding work, chase missing job sheets or reports, and highlight delays or issues to the relevant team members.
- Work closely with service engineers, the Service Controller, management and other departments to ensure information is shared effectively and work is completed on time.

The successful candidate will ideally have:-
- Experience in an administration, coordination or customer service role.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage several tasks at once.
- Excellent attention to detail and a methodical approach to record keeping.
- Clear and professional communication skills.
- Good computer skills and confidence using Microsoft Office and administrative systems.
- The ability to work independently while contributing positively to a team.
- A practical, flexible approach to resolving queries and meeting deadlines.

If you feel you are suitable for this role, please apply now stating why!

title: Service Controller
description:
Service Controller - Nationwide Service Provider Oldbury Salary: £28,000 - £30,000 + 20 days holiday + bank + pension + life assurance + full training provided
- Do you have a track record within a service administration, service co-ordination or similar capacity?
- Do you have experience in scheduling and planning maintenance work or service visits for Engineers?
- Are you looking to join a business who truly care for, nurture and develop their people?

If so, then this could well be the role that you are looking for

A nationwide service provider to the vehicle fleet industry with an enviable reputation spanning 50 years is now looking for a Service Controller to join their centre for excellence for double decks in Oldbury, West Midlands.

As Service Controller you will be part of the service administration team taking pre-planned maintenance bookings from customers and planning and scheduling of these; speaking to customers to arrange follow up visits and booking them in; interacting with Service Engineers and processing Engineer job sheets / work reports; changing the job status on internal system and ensuring all inputted data is always correct and taking ownership in service improvement initiatives and cost control.

This position would suit someone who is commercially astute and has a track record of working as a Service Controller, Service Co-ordinator, Service Administration or similar capacity ideally within an engineering or technical based business and now looking to progress their career within service operations.

You will also demonstrate strong written and verbal communication skills, a strong attention to detail; be able to interface with people at all levels and be IT proficient including the use of Office 365 including Word and Excel.

Working hours are 40 hours per week Monday to Friday 8am 5pm with a 1 hour lunchbreak.

You will be working for a business who truly care for, nurture and develop their people with proof of family members across 3 generations working for the business.
